justification.blur_min: 5th percentile of Laplacian variance on training images: sharper than the blurriest 5%.
justification.blur_poor: 1st percentile of Laplacian variance: below this the image is among the blurriest 1% (unusable).
justification.brightness_low: 5th percentile of mean gray level: darker than 95% of training images.
justification.brightness_high: 95th percentile of mean gray level: brighter than 95% of training images.
justification.contrast_min: 5th percentile of gray std-dev: flatter than 95% of training images.
justification.glare_max: 95th percentile of fraction of bright low-saturation pixels (specular glare).
justification.dark_corner_max: 95th percentile of dark pixels in the 4 corner patches (vignette / dermoscope edge).
justification.occlusion_max: 95th percentile of pixels that are almost pure black or pure white.
justification.hair_max: 95th percentile of thin dark line pixels found by blackhat filter (hair / ruler).
